slides.headline: 4 STEPS TO CLAIM FREE CRYPTO BEFORE THE POOL CLOSES
PAYBOX OPENED A SIX-FIGURE CRYPTO POOL FOR AI USERS
slides.body: MoonPay activated the PayBox airdrop for every Claude and ChatGPT account. Six figures of crypto sitting in a pool for AI users, claimable through the chatbot you already use. No separate wallet needed.

slides.headline: 1) CREATE YOUR PAYBOX ACCOUNT
slides.body: Go to the PayBox site MoonPay linked and create your account. You will also need a MoonPay account for the actual transfer. Both take under two minutes.
slides.image_prompt: Overhead angle: two hands hovering above a smartphone flat on a dark marble desk, screen radiating warm gold — only a glowing gold user-profile circle icon and a checkmark symbol visible on screen, no readable text. Deep violet ambient light pools around the phone. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh on-camera flash, slight film grain. Accent: gold against deep violet.

slides.headline: 2) CONNECT YOUR X ACCOUNT TO PAYBOX
slides.body: Inside your PayBox dashboard, find the X connection option and link your profile. One click. This ties your claim to your identity and locks your portion of the pool before it closes.

slides.headline: 3) TYPE "WHAT IS MY PORTFOLIO" IN CLAUDE OR CHATGPT
slides.body: Here is the AI part: type "What is my portfolio?" in Claude or ChatGPT. That one message completes your first transaction with the free USDC MoonPay delivers to connected accounts.

slides.headline: 4) REDEEM THE REST OF YOUR DROP
slides.body: Once that first transaction confirms, head back to the PayBox site and hit redeem. That pulls your full share from the six-figure pool into your account. Not available in the UK, Canada, or Australia.

slides.headline: OG PAYBOX USERS CAN CLAIM IN THREE STEPS
slides.body: Connect your AI agent to your existing PayBox setup. Then type "What is my portfolio?" in Claude or ChatGPT. Once that confirms, redeem the rest of your drop from the PayBox dashboard.
